pack.description: Exide traction-cell export packaging, pallet/transport, industrial B2B

scopingNotes: Non-food-contact industrial B2B packaging: PFAS limits not applicable. The scoping decision itself is a recorded evidence obligation, not an omission.

legalRole.ambiguityReason: Exide is the non-EU manufacturer; the EU importer carries importer obligations. Which party is 'manufacturer' (brand/spec owner) and which is EPR producer in each Member State of first placing must be contractually confirmed — engine flags for legal confirmation, does not assign.

expected.basis: Heat treatment is thermal, not chemical; no inherent substance of concern.
Risk only if a chemical preservative (e.g. CCA, which contains Cr(VI)) was used; declaration of heat-treatment-only closes it.
HT stamp IN-747 visible on component; treatment provider certificate on file.
Plain or trivalent-passivated steel complies; legacy Cr(VI) zinc passivation would breach the 100 mg/kg sum.
Kraft/corrugated inherently low risk; residual risk sits in inks and recycled furnish.
Composition is paper-based; water-based adhesive is not plastic content.
Mono-material and recyclable; risk limited to pigments and additives.

Only genuine chemistry risk in the BOM: green/yellow pigment families historically include lead chromate, which fails Pb and Cr(VI) simultaneously. Modern organic pigments comply but must be evidenced.
expected.note: Recorded in the manual run as 'CONDITIONAL — test recommended'. Same verdict as lines 1-6, distinguished only by risk and by pigment specification or XRF/lab test being the closing evidence rather than a routine declaration.

bomCompletenessGaps.name: Steel corner plates / clips
bomCompletenessGaps.reason: Visible on stacked crates but absent from the BOM. Conformity assessment must cover every packaging component.

bomCompletenessGaps.name: Plywood battery box system (veneer + phenolic adhesive, steel closure strips, clips, corrugated layer pad, liner)
bomCompletenessGaps.reason: Distinct packaging system absent from the BOM. Plywood is a wood-plus-adhesive composite requiring a different declaration to solid pine; steel hardware unlisted; liner material unidentified.

dataCorrections.resolution: Correct the flag or obtain the adhesive specification.
dataCorrections.forwardRisk: If any polymer film is present at 5% or more by weight, composite treatment applies.

dataCorrections.issue: Pigment does not make a material a composite; PET strap is mono-material.
Mandatory field blank; recycled-content assessment cannot be computed without it.

notApplicable.note: N/A is itself an evidence obligation — the scoping reasoning must be recorded in the technical file, not merely omitted.

forwardFlags.note: Non-contact-sensitive plastic packaging target from 2030; rPET strap and rLDPE film are the substitution route. Exact percentage is on the re-verify list and must come from EUR-Lex before this checkpoint ships.
Grades set by delegated acts. Manual run recorded 'Assessment pending', NOT 'Not applicable' — the report must not render an unassessed forward requirement as inapplicable.

packLevelExpected.subject: pack
packLevelExpected.basis: Annex VII Module A self-assessment file to be compiled covering every packaging spec.

packLevelExpected.subject: pack
packLevelExpected.basis: The obligated operator must issue a Declaration of Conformity per Annex VIII and retain it 5 years for single-use packaging. This is the user's obligation; the screening only reports whether the prerequisites are assembled.
packLevelExpected.note: Deliberate fixture case: the report must instruct the user about their DoC obligation while never presenting itself as issuing one.

packLevelExpected.subject: pack
packLevelExpected.basis: Name/trademark and postal address of manufacturer and importer to be marked on packaging.

packLevelExpected.subject: consignment
packLevelExpected.basis: Producer registration in each Member State of first placing; authorised representative where required. A branch office does not qualify as importer.
packLevelExpected.note: Subject is the consignment/market, not the pack — obligation depends on destination Member States, which the BOM does not carry.

expectedOverall.summary: No material is a design failure for the August 2026 tests; qualification is blocked by missing evidence, not chemistry.
hardBlockers: Zero heavy-metal declarations on file for any of the 7 components.
PET strap green pigment unverified — the only genuine lab-test candidate.
Components visible in consignment photos are absent from the BOM.
